name: Tri-State Tornado
notes: Deadliest single tornado in US history; ~219 mile path.

name: Tupelo-Gainesville outbreak
notes: Tupelo ~216 dead, Gainesville ~203 dead the next day.

name: Waco Tornado
notes: Ended the myth that Waco was tornado-safe.

name: Flint-Beecher Tornado
notes: Last single US tornado to kill 100+ until Joplin 2011.

name: Palm Sunday outbreak
notes: 47 tornadoes across 6 states; spurred improved warning coordination.

name: 1974 Super Outbreak
notes: 148 tornadoes in ~18 hours; US deaths 315 (335 incl. Canada).

name: Bridge Creek-Moore Tornado
notes: Recorded the highest wind speed ever measured (~302 mph).

name: Hackleburg-Phil Campbell Tornado
notes: Deadliest single tornado of the 2011 Super Outbreak.

name: 2011 Super Outbreak
notes: Largest tornado outbreak ever recorded (~360 tornadoes); drove the deadliest US tornado year since 1936.

name: Joplin Tornado
notes: Deadliest single US tornado since modern records began in 1950.

name: El Reno Tornado
notes: Widest tornado ever recorded (~2.6 miles); killed veteran storm chasers.

name: Western Kentucky / Quad-State outbreak
notes: Long-track December tornado outbreak; devastated Mayfield, KY.
